# Long-Run Frontier Synthesis

## What the four targets establish

1. Arbitrary microscopic conditioning is too strong, but a gauge-covariant
   coherent-staple collar restores a positive conditional rate gap.
2. The center-valued configuration causing Stage 10 frustration necessarily
   carries a five-plaquette contour; it is not a free one-plaquette event.
3. Shared-link and Bianchi dependence alone do not destroy the ultraviolet
   window: the exact linearized Gaussian gauge model has a strict dependent
   rooted-polymer bound at the Stage 09 witness.
4. A two-channel comparison theorem converts the Gaussian rate, nonlinear
   comparison loss, and charged collar rate into one effective connected-event
   envelope.

## Strongest combined conclusion

There is now a coherent restricted pathway from the ultraviolet local action
certificate to a dependent connected-event criterion.  At the frozen parameters, a
full nonlinear proof would close the one-scale counting gate if it supplied

```text
kappa <= 0.2,      K >= 7.0,
```

in the precise good-collar and charged-collar inequalities of the Stage 14
ledger.  These are sufficient targets, not established properties of the
`SU(2)` measure.

## Remaining Clay chain

```text
full nonlinear one-scale inequalities [OPEN]
  -> Mayer-activity construction or stochastic domination [OPEN]
  -> volume-uniform nonlinear activities [OPEN]
  -> repeated gauge-covariant RG with summable errors [OPEN]
  -> finite-physical-scale rigidity-basin entry [OPEN]
  -> cutoff and volume limits preserving OS data [OPEN]
  -> observable-complete OS reconstruction [OPEN]
```

The strongest defensible level remains `C2`: rigorous finite/restricted
theorems plus an exact conditional bridge.  No claim of continuum Yang--Mills
existence or a mass gap is made.
